Facilities

Equipment & facilities

Everything needed to take a battery material from powder to a tested cell, under inert atmosphere where it matters.

01

Inside the lab

Synthesis

Materials synthesis

  • Tube furnaces under Ar / N₂ (up to [1200] °C)
  • Planetary ball mill
  • Co-precipitation reactor for cathode precursors
  • Vacuum and drying ovens
Fabrication

Electrode fabrication

  • Dry electrode line: Thinky mixer and roll press
  • Slurry casting and doctor-blade coater
  • Electrode punching and calendering
Assembly

Cell assembly

  • Ar-filled gloveboxes (H₂O, O₂ < 0.1 ppm)
  • Coin-cell crimper
  • All-solid-state cell molds and pressure fixtures
Testing

Electrochemical testing

  • Battery cyclers: [brand, channels]
  • Potentiostat / EIS: [brand]
  • Temperature-controlled chambers
Analysis

Characterization

  • XRD, SEM / EDS, TEM
  • XPS and Raman spectroscopy
  • Through Chosun University shared facilities
